subject: Bridge letter + evidence timeline request for post-report coverage (SOC 2 Type II)
messages:
From: Mandy Tang <mandy.tang@alceramed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security@alceramed.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for bridge letter and interim evidence for SOC 2 period

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well — AlceraMed is finalizing our vendor assurances for an upcoming board review and we need a short bridge letter from Redwood to cover the post-report period following your SOC 2 Type II report that ended 2027-03-31. Specifically we need:

- A signed bridge/continuity letter that confirms controls in-scope for the SOC 2 report remained in place and operational from 2027-04-01 through 2027-04-19 (current date).
- A compact evidence bundle (PDFs or Drive links) that demonstrates continuity for a small set of controls: KMS key rotation logs, change-control records for any production config changes in April, and any security incident/response summaries since 2027-03-31 (if none, a confirmation of none).

Our timeline is tight — can Redwood provide the signed letter + evidence package by EOD 2027-04-30? If you have a standard template we can accept that, and we’ll need the signatory name/title for our procurement paperwork.

If there are any items you cannot produce (e.g., raw logs), a short explanation and a summary artifact is acceptable. Please let me know the expected delivery date and who from Redwood will lead.

Thanks,
Mandy Tang
Senior Security Manager
AlceraMed
mandy.tang@alceramed.com

Attachment: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for bridge letter and interim evidence for SOC 2 period

Hi Mandy — thanks for the clear note and timeline. We can support this request.

Quick plan and owners:
- Redwood will prepare a signed bridge/continuity letter (draft to AlceraMed for review) — owner: Kimberly Park (SOC 2 program lead).
- Evidence bundle: we’ll assemble KMS rotation summary, change-control export for March–April, and an incident statement (or a confirmed "no incidents" summary) — owner: Priyom Das.
- Legal sign-off: Marissa Cole will review the letter for wording around representations.

Requested timeline from our side:
- 2027-04-23: Kimberly to provide first draft of bridge letter.
- 2027-04-27: Compliance to assemble evidence package (PDFs + short index).
- 2027-04-28: Legal review complete; finalize letter for signature.
- 2027-04-29: Execute signature and share final package to AlceraMed (target 2027-04-29, within your 4/30 deadline).

I attached a short checklist to confirm the items we plan to include and a PDF extract of the SOC 2 report for context. If you need the letter to reference specific auditor wording, please paste the preferred phrasing or examples.

Next steps for you: please confirm the signatory name and whether AlceraMed needs the letter on company letterhead + notarization (we typically provide signed on Redwood letterhead; notarization is uncommon but we can explore).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate updates to the thread and loop Kimberly and Marissa for next steps.

Best,
Priyom Das
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

- bridge-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub)
